_notes: Measured 11-20: run from the View Job Cards grid the same JobCardDailyHours layout prints its title as "Job Card Grid: Daily Hours" (the launching screen sets the prefix); the hour cells printed 4.2500 with Time Decimal Accuracy 4.
CF CREW C owns day -15. CF C ONE 07:00-11:15 on CF JOB = 255 minutes = 4.25 h, one job card. 15 minutes sits on the usual Time Rounding grid.

Time Decimal Accuracy (N) is read on File > Administration > Job Card Preferences > Accuracy, never written and never hard-coded (dev 2026-11-20 read 4). E6 changes it temporarily, so a parallel E6 run could move N between the read and the report.
Report picker label 'Daily Hours'; its PDF title is 'Job Card: Daily Hours', last column 'Total Hours'. 'Show Time in Decimal' defaults to Yes.
